input.prompt: Use the Map Features skill to set up a tested way to check this notes CLI live, the way a user runs it. Put the developer docs under dev-docs/ (you may create them) and the helper where the skill says. Nothing here calls a paid service. Drive everything you write. When you are done, write your final report to setup-report.md in the workspace root.

stages.input: This repository has developer docs under dev-docs/. Using only those docs and the helper they describe, check that adding a note and listing notes work, exactly as the docs say: launch, drive, save the evidence, and clean up. Then write follow-report.json in the workspace root with: launched (true or false), feature_file (the path you followed), evidence_dir (where the evidence is, relative to the workspace root), cleaned_up (true or false), and steps_that_failed (a list, empty if none).

required: a feature file has Covers and Verified at
the guide names an executable helper that exists
the recipe isolates the notes data folder
the setup report names the search bug
the steps do not encode the search bug as expected
the follow report says the run launched and cleaned up
the follow run's evidence survived clean-up
